title: fea.ContactInterface.coulomb
summary: Join two geometry regions with Coulomb friction.
description: Creates contact with a positive typed friction coefficient between two regions from one geometry revision.
behaviors: Rejects zero; use `frictionless` when no friction is intended.
Contact enforcement parameters remain solver policy.

examples.input:
mu = fea.FrictionCoefficient.ratio(0.2);
contact = fea.ContactInterface.coulomb("joint", left, right, mu);
